description: Authoritative Runtime Eval provider registry. scripts/providers_contract.py is the only executable adapter for this data. Do not hand-copy provider ID lists into another Validator.

ollama.label: Ollama (local)
ollama.requires: a local Ollama daemon reachable at --ollama-url with the requested model pulled

codex.label: Codex CLI (GPT)
codex.requires: the codex CLI installed and authenticated via `codex login`

claude.label: Claude Code CLI (Claude)
claude.requires: the claude CLI installed and authenticated via `claude auth login`

extension_guide: Local backend: add scripts/local_providers/<name>_adapter.py exposing a call(...) function with the same signature as call_ollama in scripts/run_runtime_evals.py, then add a 'family': 'local' entry here.

Hosted-agent backend: add scripts/<name>_eval_adapter.py exposing <name>_preflight() and call_<name>_cli(...) mirroring scripts/codex_eval_adapter.py or scripts/claude_eval_adapter.py, then add a 'family': 'hosted-agent' entry here.
Add the new provider ID literal to the --provider choices/case-statement in every path listed in required_consumer_paths.
